title: IVE Overlay Schema
description: Single schema for any overlay, regardless of target technology. Technology/concept-specific rules (Java, trigger, ...) are expressed as conditional (if/then) blocks below, keyed off the TARGET PATH itself (not a nested content shape) — matching how overlays are actually written in this project: the target path navigates directly to the extension node, and the type-specific fields are the DIRECT properties of that same target entry.

description.description: Descripción breve de para qué sirve este overlay - opcional, solo documentación.

javaExtension.description: `basePackage` is intentionally OPTIONAL here — it can also come from `vars.basePkgPath` in ive.config.json, resolved via the `javaPackageFromPath` helper inside adapter.hbs. Whether AT LEAST ONE of these two sources supplies it can't be expressed in this schema alone (that would require checking a separate file) — enforce it in application code instead.

packages.description: e.g. { intents: '...', flow: '...', api: '...' } — per-artifact-group Java package suffixes.

triggerExtension.description: What invokes a Flow (or, in principle, an Intent) — deliberately an implementation detail, not part of the conceptual spec (an Intent/Flow's meaning never depends on who/what calls it — see the Intent definition itself). 'invocation' is the default assumed when no trigger overlay is present at all; it's included here as an explicit option too, for clarity.

timezone.description: IANA timezone, e.g. 'America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires'. Defaults to the deploying system's own timezone if omitted.

channel.description: The channel/topic this Flow reacts to.

name.description: The broadcast signal name this Flow reacts to.

expression.description: A boolean expression, engine/language not prescribed by this schema — evaluated by whatever generation target implements this trigger type.
